scenes.line1: How do teams ship fast, safely?
scenes.say: How do top teams ship code fast and safely? What's the real secret behind smooth releases?

scenes.label: Branch
scenes.sub: Work in branches, commit, push, open pull requests
scenes.say: It all starts with Git. You work in branches, commit your changes, push, and open pull requests for review.
Next, the pipeline takes over. It builds your code, runs tests, and deploys to the next environment—all automatically.
For infrastructure, Terraform describes what you need in code and tracks it. Ansible configures servers and makes sure changes are repeatable.

scenes.title: Jenkinsfile example
scenes.say: With Jenkins, your pipeline steps live in code too. The Jenkinsfile lists each stage—build, test, deploy—so nothing is manual.

scenes.question: Why use infrastructure as code?
scenes.wrong: So I can click less in the portal.
scenes.right: It makes changes repeatable, reviewable, and keeps every environment identical—no snowflake servers.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Why use infrastructure as code? It's not just to avoid clicking around. The real reason is repeatability, review, and identical environments every time.
